Welcome to No Dough Bakery, where indulgence meets better choices. Founded by registered dietitian Aahat Sajnani, we’re redefining treats with our nutritionally balanced, plant-based, gluten-free creations that are as good for your body as they are for your taste buds.

It all started when Aahat, frustrated by the lack of truly nourishing options on the market, decided to bake her own solutions. Combining her expertise in nutrition with a love for baking, she created a line of treats that deliver on flavor while supporting your overall wellness.

What Makes Us Different?

  • Refined Sugar-Free & Nutritionally Balanced

No sugar bombs or energy crashes here. Our treats are designed to support steady blood sugar levels, keeping your insulin response healthy and your energy stable.

  • Made from Scratch

From grinding our own oat flour to making our own chocolate, we take pride in doing everything ourselves for the highest quality.

  • Gut-Friendly & Gluten-Free

No processed GF flours that are tough to digest. We use sprouted oats, sprouted nut flours, and easily digestible millets, making our products gentle on your gut.

  • No Refined Oils

We only use unrefined virgin coconut oil, avocado oil, or olive oil—clean and nourishing, just like the rest of our ingredients.

  • No Artificial or Zero-Calorie Sweeteners

These disrupt your gut lining and hunger signals. Instead, our treats are balanced with healthy fats and carbs to keep you full, nourished, and satisfied all day long.

At No Dough Bakery, we believe that treating yourself doesn’t have to mean compromising your health. Whether you’re gluten-free, plant-based, or just looking for a better way to indulge, our treats are here to prove that healthy and delicious can coexist.
